A '''tractor''' was a vehicle used on a [[Farm/Legends|farm]].<ref name="CRO7">{{JournalCite|7|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[File:legostarwarstractor.jpg|thumb|right|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] riding a tractor on Dagobah.]]
A disassembled tractor was found in the swamps of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], and one was found in an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] village on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].
{{Noncanonend}}
